name: Nakagawa Shinobu
source:
Nakagawa Shinobu finally made it. Overcoming the early death of his parents, he kept his heart on his goal of becoming a great doctor. Now he's right where he wants to be; working as a pediatrician in a hospital, helping kids overcome illness, and surrounded by pretty nurses. When he gets a call to give all that up, you would think his response would be a resounding no. But how do you turn down a request from the [url=https://vndb.org/c42430]woman who raised you[/url]?

So Shinobu finds himself transferred to a nursing school. While there may not be patients to heal, the job does come with an abundance of pretty nurses... well, student nurses. And quite a few of the women he meets develop, or already possess, a grand crush on the young physician. How well will he be able to juggle romance and a demanding new job?

Okay, Shinobu's not a saint. He likes the ladies and has no problem sneaking a little peek if the opportunity presents itself. But he's also a good teacher, and he really cares about how his students perform, even if he is a little easy on them.

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582494-kango-shicyauzo/faqs/36050]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
